paragraphs.text: Mindosz was an unlucky Izzet magelord who dared to oppose Niv-Mizzet 's opinion, claiming that the metal mizzium was not so impervious as was said and that it was possible to create temperatures that could melt it. Niv-Mizzet strongly disagreed, and Mindosz, earning the title Heretic, was immolated by the Firemind's breath in 3203 Z.C. Ironically, Mindosz’s death resulted from one of the few things that could actually melt mizzium, dragon fire.
